name: Cariel Roame
guide_text: Every other turn, click the option that gives to an extra minion. This hero gets a lot of free stats early game which allows you to level fast without taking damage. Most of the time, level to tavern 3 turn 4 and tavern 4 turn 5 without taking damage.
